upstream.latestChange: No new BWM repository commit since 4818511; main Proxmark3 upstream now adds explicit BWM capability gating, BLE settings, byte-window flow control, wireless abort polling, Wi-Fi/PM5/BWM power-save and auto-off controls.
upstream.ciMeaning: CI build/package success is evidence of firmware buildability only; it is not physical hardware verification.

transport.flowControl: PM5 upstream byte-window flow control is now tied to the ESP UART receive ring; physical end-to-end verification remains separate.

chargerPolicy.reason: No verified PM5+BWM charger-register write/readback path has been established on physical hardware.
chargerPolicy.note: The Control Center must not silently apply a guessed charge-voltage target. Battery chemistry and production charge limits remain hardware/pack specific.

evidenceRule: Upstream source and CI evidence must never be promoted to HARDWARE_VERIFIED without reproducible observation on a physical PM5+BWM unit.
integrationPolicy: Control Center may display source-backed capabilities and verified device telemetry separately, but must not invent telemetry or perform unverified charger configuration.
